Contextual matching core, ported from harfrust ot/lookup/context.rs + ot/apply.rs (SkippingIterator, match walks).

Simplified: no digests, no syllable cache, no default-ignorable special-casing (TODO, mirrors harfrust MaySkip/digest optimization). Skips glyphs failing the lookup props; input matching additionally requires the feature mask, backtrack/lookahead ignore it.

                       kind: ValueKind; classDef: ClassDef;

Matches backtrack against already-emitted output, nearest first. seq[0] is the glyph immediately before the current one. Ignores the feature mask. anchorSyllable constrains to one syllable when nonzero. 
proc matchInputSeq(buf: Buffer; props, lookupMask: uint32;
                   seq: openArray[uint32]; kind: ValueKind; classDef: ClassDef;
                   coverages: openArray[Coverage]; anchorSyllable: uint8 = 0'u8): Option[
    tuple[positions: seq[int], matchEnd: int]] {....raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Matches seq against input glyphs after the current one, skipping ignorables per props. First glyph (buf.idx) is implied by coverage. Requires the feature mask on every matched input glyph. coverages holds per-position coverages for format-3 input (same length as seq); otherwise empty. When anchorSyllable is nonzero, consumed glyphs must share that syllable (per-syllable matching for the Indic-family shapers). seq/coverages are openArray to avoid copies on format-3 slices.

    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Matches lookahead from start (input index after the input match). Returns the end index on success. Ignores the feature mask. anchorSyllable constrains to one syllable when nonzero.
